Container.Name: steam-headless
Container.Overview:
Steam Headless is a containerised gaming desktop with Steam and Sunshine pre-installed.
See the Steam Headless documentation for setup, GPU configuration and troubleshooting: https://steamheadless.com/docs/installation/host-preparation/unraid
WARNING: Host networking supports one Steam Headless container only. To run more than one, use macvlan networking and configure unique hostname values and appdata paths for every container.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Steam Fedora KDE Plasma Wayland Gamescope Sunshine Moonlight NVIDIA AMD Intel VA-API NVENC
Container.ExtraParams: --hostname=steam-headless --security-opt writable-cgroups=true --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --security-opt systempaths=unconfined --cgroupns private --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --cap-add SYS_PTRACE --cap-add NET_ADMIN --cap-add DAC_READ_SEARCH --cap-add SYS_NICE --device-cgroup-rule 'c 13:* rwm' --stop-signal SIGRTMIN+3 --stop-timeout 30 --pids-limit 8192 --shm-size 2g -t --tmpfs /run --tmpfs /run/lock --tmpfs /tmp --tmpfs /dev/input:rw,dev,mode=0755
Container.Requires:
NVIDIA users: install the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin and append --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters. Set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to a specific device ID when the host has multiple NVIDIA GPUs and only one should be passed into the container.
See https://steamheadless.com/docs/installation/deployment/unraid-template/ for all requirements.

Config.Name: User Profile
Config.Description: Persistent Steam profile, Proton prefixes, desktop settings and browser state. Keep on a direct cache-pool or disk path, never a /mnt/user FUSE share, and private to this container.

Config.Name: Steam Headless State
Config.Description: Persistent settings, TLS certificates and Sunshine pairing keys. Use the direct cache-pool default, not a /mnt/user FUSE share. Set this alongside User Profile when changing the appdata location.

Config.Name: System Journal
Config.Description: Persistent system and service logs. Use the direct cache-pool default, not a /mnt/user FUSE share, or SHUI may be unable to read logs. Set this alongside User Profile when changing the appdata location.

Config.Name: Game Library
Config.Description: Steam library path. Use a direct disk or Unassigned Devices path, not a /mnt/user share.

Config.Name: GPU Render Node
Config.Description: GPU rendering and hardware encoding device. Run 'for node in /sys/class/drm/renderD*; do pci=$(basename $(readlink -f $node/device)); echo /dev/dri/$(basename $node) - $(lspci -s $pci); done' to list render nodes with their GPU vendor and model.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Numeric host user ID that should own the persistent profile and games files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Numeric host group ID that should own the persistent profile and games files.

Config.Name: Display Width
Config.Description: Initial virtual Wayland display width in pixels for a fresh desktop profile.

Config.Name: Display Height
Config.Description: Initial virtual Wayland display height in pixels for a fresh desktop profile.

Config.Name: Display Refresh
Config.Description: Initial virtual Wayland display refresh rate in Hertz for a fresh desktop profile.

Config.Name: Local Time
Config.Description: Provides the host timezone to the container.

Config.Name: Input Discovery
Config.Description: Read-only virtual-input sysfs required by the container's virtual-input service.

Config.Name: FUSE Filesystem
Config.Description: Required by Flatpak and AppImage sandboxing.

Config.Name: Virtual Input
Config.Description: Required for virtual keyboard, mouse and controller input.

Config.Name: Virtual HID
Config.Description: Required for virtual HID controller emulation.

Config.Name: Session Mode
Config.Description: Initial frontend mode. Use desktop for KDE Plasma or gaming for nested Gamescope and Steam Gamepad UI.

Config.Name: Desktop Steam Autostart
Config.Description: Starts the optional Steam desktop client while Desktop Mode is active.

Config.Name: Virtual Seat
Config.Description: [OPTIONAL] Advanced virtual input seat name. Leave blank to generate one automatically from the container identity.

Config.Name: Compositor Render Device
Config.Description: [OPTIONAL] DRM render device used by the desktop compositor. Leave blank to select the first available render node.

Config.Name: Encoder Render Device
Config.Description: [OPTIONAL] DRM render device used by SHUI and Sunshine for hardware video encoding. Leave blank to use the compositor render device.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime selection. Defaults to all NVIDIA GPUs; set a specific NVIDIA device ID when the host has multiple NVIDIA GPUs and only one should be passed into the container.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities. All provides graphics, compute and NVENC video libraries.
